name: Time Duration Calculator
summary: Measure the duration between two datetimes or convert days, hours, minutes, and seconds — locally.
description: Enter a start and end datetime to get a breakdown in days, hours, minutes, and seconds. Or build a duration from units and see equivalent values in weeks through milliseconds. Runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Does it use my local timezone?
faqs.answer: Yes. Datetime fields are interpreted as local wall time in your browser.

faqs.question: What if end is before start?
faqs.answer: The duration is shown as negative so you can see the direction of the gap.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Calculation runs entirely in your browser.
